price_key names the live price that replaces the 2025 price: urea (Nitrogen, $/cwt of product), dap (Phosphate 46%, $/cwt), potash ($/cwt), diesel ($/gal), wage ($/hour).
index names the BLS producer price index that carries a 2025 price forward: ag_chemicals (herbicides, insecticides), machinery_parts (repairs), ag_machinery (fixed machinery costs).
Items with neither keep the MSU 2025 price. Interest on operating capital is left out here; the herd budget charges interest on all operating costs once.
